FINAL ANSWER: 3,815 non-reference exonic variants in CHIP genes across the 86 analyzed samples.

This is the primary count under the approved rules: per-sample Het/Hom variant calls (all Zygosity='Reference' and blank/no-call rows removed), exonic SO terms only (synonymous_variant, missense_variant, frameshift_variant, inframe_insertion, inframe_deletion; intronic/UTR/upstream-intergenic/splice_region excluded), gene matching against the parsed 56-gene CHIP list, exact-duplicate row removal within each sample, no cross-sample deduplication.

Funnel (all 86 files): 57,258 total rows → 11,896 non-reference variant calls (Het 7,303 + Hom 4,593) → 4,060 exonic → 3,815 after CHIP-gene filter (245 removed) → 3,815 after within-sample dedup (0 exonic duplicates). Mean 44.4 per sample (range 33–58).

Sensitivity figures: including splice_region_variant as exonic → 4,251; counting unique variant positions across all samples instead of per-sample calls → 264.

In_CHIP cross-check: 860 rows among variant calls carry In_CHIP=True while no gene in their comma-separated Gene Names matches the parsed 56-gene list (flagFalse/geneYes = 0); the offending genes are non-list neighbors such as MMACHC, SF3B2, MMAB, TET2-AS1, MFSD11. Per instruction these were resolved in favor of the parsed 56-gene list (i.e., excluded), which is exactly what the 3,815 figure reflects.
